title: Building a browser-based aerobatic air race game using Three.js with an AI-assisted hybrid workflow
author: Then-Creme9892
selftext:
Hey everyone! I wanted to share a browser-based aerobatic air race project I've been developing called **Brickwing Stunt Break Air Race**, powered entirely by Three.js so it runs instantly in the browser with no downloads required.

The gameplay features a full loop: a 360-degree garage orbit camera view, dynamic M-14 engine audio states (`E` key trigger), low-altitude valley slaloms, and precise runway touchdown physics.

**How I built it:** For the visual pipeline, I handled all the 3D asset breakdown, modeling, and environment design using Blender and LEGO Studio. For the architecture and codebase, I paired up with my AI development stack to fast-track the coding loop, optimize the Three.js pipeline, and build out the flight physics logic. For the soundscape, I handled the audio design and procedural states to match the flight pacing.

Would love to hear your thoughts on the workflow, browser performance, or the control scheme!
